description:
New to the Market – Luxury 4 Bedroom Detached Bungalow with Home Office
Woodview, Ballindrimley, Castlerea, Co. Roscommon
Guide Price: €320,000

Nigel Dineen & Martin Finn Auctioneers are proud to present this exceptional 4-bedroom detached bungalow with separate home office / additional accommodation, coming to the market in true showhouse condition throughout.

Set on an elevated, mature site in a highly sought-after residential area, this property offers the perfect blend of privacy, space and convenience, all within walking distance of Castlerea Town Centre.

Enjoy immediate access to schools, banks, shops, Castlerea Train Station and the beautiful Castlerea Demesne Park with its scenic walkways right on your doorstep.

The location also offers excellent connectivity — 20 minutes to Knock Airport, 20 minutes to Roscommon Town and approximately 1 hour 10 minutes to Galway City.

This is a home that delivers quality, finish and lifestyle in equal measure.

Accommodation Comprises:

Entrance Hall:
Impressive hallway with solid oak timber flooring, long corridor layout, Stira stairs to attic, feature lighting and storage.

Living Room:
Finished to a high standard with oak timber flooring, solid fuel stove with white granite surround and hearth, fitted curtains and blinds, coving, wall lights and feature centre light.

Sitting Room:
Bright dual-aspect room with timber flooring, solid fuel stove with cream granite surround, fitted curtains and blinds, coving and feature lighting.

Kitchen / Dining Area:
Beautiful oak fitted kitchen, tiled splashback and flooring, gas cooker with extractor, fitted blinds and PVC door leading to rear garden.

Bedrooms:
Bedroom 1: Oak timber flooring, fitted curtains

Bedroom 2: Carpeted, fitted wardrobe, curtains and blinds

Bedroom 3: Oak flooring with double fitted wardrobes, curtains and blinds

Bedroom 4: Oak flooring, hotpress and storage, curtains and blinds

Main Bathroom:
White suite with vanity unit and mirror, fully tiled floor and walls, and walk-in electric shower.

Additional Accommodation / Workshop:

A standout feature of this property is the attached large workshop / home office / utility space, complete with:
Heating system
ESB connected
Fully plumbed for appliances
Multiple sockets
Upstairs home office / additional bedroom
Stunning countryside views to the rear
Ideal for remote working, business use or additional living space.

Outside & Grounds:
Elevated mature site with landscaped gardens front and rear
Private tarmac driveway with ample parking
Two open storage / fuel sheds
Mature hedging and shrubbery
Beautiful open countryside views to the rear

Key Features:
Showhouse condition throughout
4-bedroom detached bungalow with additional accommodation
Prime residential location within walking distance of town
Mains water and sewage connected
Dual solid fuel stoves with granite surrounds
Large workshop / home office with further potential

This is a rare opportunity to acquire a turnkey, high-quality home in a premium location offering space, flexibility and lifestyle.

Viewing is highly recommended and strictly by appointment.
